abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.description: Restore an ally with a flash of warm light, or sear an enemy with it.

abilities.name: Feral Spirit
abilities.description: Summon two allied forest spirits for 60 seconds. Recasting replaces this caster’s previous spirits. Summons can be damaged by Dispel Magic.

abilities.name: Dispel Magic
abilities.description: Remove dispellable positive and negative spell statuses in an area. Enemy summoned units also take 200 spell damage; auras and unremovable stuns remain.

abilities.name: Storm Bolt
abilities.description: Hurl a lightning-charged bolt. It deals damage on impact and stuns the target; heroes recover sooner.

abilities.name: Entangling Roots
abilities.description: Living roots prevent movement and attacks while dealing periodic damage. The target may still cast spells.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.description: Send a travelling seismic wave through enemies in a line. Each unit can be struck once per cast.

abilities.name: Vampiric Aura
abilities.description: Nearby friendly melee units recover 15% of the actual damage dealt by their ordinary melee attacks. Multiple copies do not stack.

abilities.name: Thorns Aura
abilities.description: A living bramble ward surrounds nearby allies. Returns 20% of actual ordinary melee damage to the attacker as spell damage. Ranged attacks and spells do not trigger reflection; multiple copies do not stack.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: Lightning jumps to four distinct enemies. Each jump deals 15% less damage, choosing the nearest visible enemy.

abilities.name: Verdant Ward
abilities.description: Restore 125 health to a friendly unit and grant a shield that absorbs 100 damage for up to 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Frost Relay
abilities.description: Icy energy strikes an enemy for 80 spell damage, then relays to up to three more distinct nearby enemies within 7 units of each victim. Each jump retains 80% damage. Every victim is slowed by 30% for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Ember Garden
abilities.description: Plant a glowing fire garden in a 3-unit radius for six seconds, dealing 20 spell damage to enemies inside each second. The caster is free to move immediately after release.

abilities.name: Amber Mend
abilities.description: Warm golden healing restores 90 health to an ally, then jumps to up to three other wounded allies within 8 units. Each jump retains 80% healing; no target is visited twice.

abilities.name: Moonpetal Ward
abilities.description: Wrap yourself in a cool lunar ward that absorbs up to 160 damage for eight seconds. Moon-petal glyphs orbit and breathe beneath you.

abilities.name: Dewspring
abilities.description: Place a gentle turquoise spring on targeted ground for five seconds. Allies within radius 4 are healed for 20 each second. The spring persists independently after casting ends.

abilities.name: Cinder Pin
abilities.description: Fire a quick cinder at one enemy, dealing 70 spell damage and rooting them for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.description: Channel a storm over a fixed area. Six waves of falling ice strike enemies; moving or being stunned ends the storm.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: Empower an ally with 40% faster attacks and 25% faster movement for 60 seconds. Right-click its command to toggle autocast.

abilities.name: Spore Sanctuary
abilities.description: Create a stationary mushroom sanctuary on targeted ground for five seconds. Allies within radius 4 receive 20 healing each second. The mushroom cluster is cosmetic, not a summon, and the patch persists independently after casting.

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.description: Summon one forest spirit at the chosen ground position, then damage and stun nearby enemies. The summon is independent of target count.

abilities.name: Rallying Spark
abilities.description: Requires an injured ally (missing health > 0). Heal the primary for 100, then chain to up to three other injured allies within 8 units per jump, retaining 75% healing with integer rounding (100/75/56/42). Full-health units are skipped; enemies are never recipients. Each recipient gains +2 armor for 120 ticks (3 seconds), including a recipient restored to full health by this heal.

abilities.name: Grove Nursery
abilities.description: Raise an immobile nursery for 40 seconds. It produces one forest spirit every 5/4/3 seconds, up to six at a time. Spirits last 30 seconds, burst for 40/60/80 spell damage on death, and vanish with the nursery. Recasting replaces the nursery. Factory composition inspired by Pocket Factory, using our existing Mound and forest-spirit assets.

abilities.name: Spirit Swarm
abilities.description: Release twenty untargetable seekers over 3.8 seconds. They pursue nearby visible enemies for 30 seconds, sharing targets with at most seven per victim. Each bite drains 10 health; 75% is carried home, delivered only when a seeker returns after collecting 20 health or four bites. Seekers follow their moving caster and stop when it dies or changes control.

abilities.name: Spirit Trinity
abilities.description: Become three controllable forest spirits for 60 seconds: Earth (War Stomp), Storm (Chain Lightning), and Fire (Immolation). The original caster returns beside the first survivor in that order, with full health and mana. Losing all three bodies kills the original. The caster retains its inventory, progression and supply cost; spirit bodies cannot be converted, swallowed or garrisoned.

abilities.name: Ashstep
abilities.description: Blink to clear ground within 20 units, then immediately deal 70 spell damage to enemies within 4 units of the actual landing position. Departure causes no damage.

abilities.name: Charm
abilities.description: Permanently take control of a visible enemy non-hero organic or undead unit. Neutral creatures above level 5 resist. The unit keeps health, equipment and learned spells; its old commands end. Can exceed supply capacity, but never the hard unit limit.

abilities.name: Death Pact
abilities.description: Sacrifice one owned non-hero unit to restore 100/200/300% of its maximum health to the caster, capped by missing health. The sacrifice must succeed; enemy units, allied players’ units and heroes cannot be consumed.

abilities.name: Dark Ritual
abilities.description: Sacrifice one owned non-hero unit to restore mana equal to 33/66/100% of its maximum health, capped by missing mana. Cost 25 mana, cooldown 15 seconds. A failed sacrifice grants nothing.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.description: Swallow one visible enemy non-hero organic or undead unit. It stays out of combat while taking 5 spell damage each second, still using its original owner’s supply. Killing or converting the carrier releases the survivor. Cannot swallow another occupied carrier.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description: Relocate the caster to clear ground at the chosen point. Blocked arrivals are rejected before spending mana.

abilities.name: Mass Teleport
abilities.description: After three seconds of preparation, relocate up to twelve nearby allies, including the caster, around the targeted allied unit or building. Individual blocked arrivals stay in place.

abilities.name: Far Sight
abilities.description: Reveal a remote eight-unit radius for twelve seconds, ignoring terrain occlusion. The vision remains after the caster dies, then fades to explored fog.

abilities.name: Wind Walk
abilities.description: Fade from enemy sight over 0.4 seconds for ten seconds and move 30% faster. A successful attack reveals the caster and adds 60 physical damage; casting another spell also reveals. Detection counters the concealment.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.description: Conceal an ally after a short fade, for fifteen seconds. Attacking or casting removes the enchantment. Area damage can still hit the hidden unit, and detection reveals it.

abilities.name: True Sight
abilities.description: A passive detector reveals concealed enemies within twelve units, provided ordinary sight and line of sight also reach them. Detection alone does not reveal unexplored terrain.

abilities.name: Healing Wave
abilities.description: A restorative chain jumps between up to four allies, losing 15% healing per jump.

abilities.name: Tranquility
abilities.description: Channel ten healing pulses around the caster. Movement or disabling the caster interrupts the channel.

abilities.name: Frost Armor
abilities.description: Grant five armor. Melee attackers are chilled for four seconds after landing a hit.

abilities.name: Anti-magic Shell
abilities.description: Protect an ally from spell damage for ten seconds. Weapon damage still passes through.

abilities.name: Spell Ward
abilities.description: Protect an allied unit from hostile spell operations for six seconds, including damage, control, mana drain and ordinary dispels. Friendly healing still works. Existing periodic spell damage is suppressed while protected. Explicitly piercing spells bypass this ward.

abilities.name: Mana Shield
abilities.description: Toggle a protective field. Each mana absorbs two damage; any damage beyond the available mana reaches health.

abilities.name: Lightning Shield
abilities.description: Place an eight-second electrical field on a unit. Its pulses damage nearby enemies of the caster.

abilities.name: Absorption Shield
abilities.description: An ally absorbs up to 150 damage before its shield pool is exhausted.

abilities.name: Silence
abilities.description: Prevent enemy spellcasting for six seconds. Movement and weapon attacks remain available.

abilities.name: War Stomp
abilities.description: Stomp the ground, damaging and stunning enemies within five metres of the caster.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.description: Strike the primary target with frost, then damage and slow surrounding enemies without repeating the primary hit.

abilities.name: Hex
abilities.description: Transform an enemy into a small tree frog for eight seconds (three against heroes). It cannot attack, cast spells or use items and moves 70% slower. Dispelling restores its original appearance and capabilities.

abilities.name: Web
abilities.description: Wrap an airborne enemy in silk, forcing a safe landing and rooting it for 6 seconds (3 on heroes). It resumes its underlying movement when the web ends. If no nearby ground is clear it remains airborne until a safe landing opens.

abilities.name: Howl of Terror
abilities.description: Reduce nearby enemies’ attack damage by 30% for twelve seconds.

abilities.name: Armor Hex
abilities.description: Reduce armor by eight for twelve seconds. This proof exercises signed armor; it does not grant vision.

abilities.name: Sleep
abilities.description: Put an enemy to sleep. Actual health damage wakes it; absorbed damage does not.

abilities.name: Flame Strike
abilities.description: Ignite a fixed ground area for eight seconds. It continues after the caster moves or dies.

abilities.name: Immolation
abilities.description: Toggle a moving fire area that damages enemies every second and consumes five mana per pulse.

abilities.name: Death and Decay
abilities.description: Channel for 35 pulses, once per second. Each pulse deals spell damage equal to 4% of each recipient’s current maximum health, including the caster, allies and buildings in the area. Damage protection still applies. Adapted from Warcraft III; terrain is unaffected.

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.description: Channel for ten seconds, draining health once per second and restoring only the health actually removed. Movement, disabling the caster or breaking the ten-metre tether ends it.

abilities.name: Siphon Mana
abilities.description: Channel a ten-metre tether that transfers available mana from the target each second. Stops when interrupted or the target leaves range.

abilities.name: Mana Burn
abilities.description: Remove up to fifty available mana, then deal spell damage equal to the mana actually removed.

abilities.name: Death Coil
abilities.description: A homing coil heals allied undead for 200 health or deals 100 spell damage to enemy organic units. Mechanical targets and the opposite class/relationship combinations are invalid.

abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.description: Heal an allied organic unit for 200 health, or deal 100 spell damage to an enemy undead unit. Mechanical targets and the opposite class/relationship combinations are invalid.

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description: Weapon hits have a 25% chance to deal 25 bonus damage and stun the victim for one second.

abilities.name: Roar
abilities.description: Empower nearby allies with additional attack damage. Modifier strength follows the selected rank.

abilities.name: Avatar
abilities.description: Grow to 160% visual size for twenty seconds, gaining 300 maximum health, 20 damage, 5 armor and immunity to spell damage. Adds up to 300 health on transformation; expiry caps health at the normal maximum. Physical clearance remains unchanged.

abilities.name: Metamorphosis
abilities.description: Transform into an enlarged ant archer for twenty seconds. Uses the archer weapon profile and real arrows, gains 100 maximum health and 20 damage, and restores the original weapon on expiry. Existing projectiles finish their flight. Body clearance remains unchanged.

abilities.name: Evasion
abilities.description: Avoid 15/25/35% of direct weapon hits. Evasion is checked when melee or arrows land, before shields and on-hit effects. Spells, cleave and siege splash cannot be evaded. The strongest evasion chance applies.

abilities.name: Cleaving Attack
abilities.description: Successful melee hits also deal 30/45/60% of raw attack damage to at most 16 other enemies in a five-unit, 120-degree forward arc. Each target mitigates damage normally. Cleave cannot trigger weapon-hit procs or another cleave.

abilities.name: Critical Strike
abilities.description: Direct melee and arrow attacks have a 25/30/35% chance to deal 2/2.5/3 times weapon damage. The strongest successful critical applies before armor; rolled arrow damage survives travel and buff expiry.

abilities.name: Battle Rhythm
abilities.description: Every third committed attack against an enemy unit grants 15/25/35% attack speed for four seconds. Cancelled windups do not count; released attacks count even if they miss. Refreshes the same buff. A custom attack-release proof; enable Combat to try it.

abilities.name: Death Burst
abilities.description: A volatile neutral creature bursts when it dies, dealing 80/120/160 spell damage to nearby enemies within 6 units. Death chains resolve in a stable order; physical removal, hidden deaths and saved games keep the same result.

abilities.name: Soul Harvest
abilities.description: A passive lifecycle proof: killing an enemy organic or undead unit restores 40/60/80 health and 10/15/20 mana. Summons and structures grant no reward. Requires a living credited killer; rescue, friendly kills and later overkill do not count.

abilities.name: Doom
abilities.description: Curses a non-hero organic enemy, dealing 40 spell damage each second until death. The curse cannot be dispelled. When the victim dies, a forest spirit manifests for the original caster’s player for 180 seconds, even if that caster has died. Classic Doom lifecycle proof; uses our existing forest spirit in place of a Doom Guard.

abilities.name: Black Arrow
abilities.description: Toggle shadow arrows: six mana per shot for 2/10/20 bonus damage. Damaging hits curse organic non-heroes for two seconds. If a cursed target dies, a lesser, standard or greater shadow spirit rises for the archer’s team for 80 seconds, according to ability rank.

abilities.name: Resurrection
abilities.description: Return up to six nearby fallen allied units to life at full health and zero mana, strongest first. Units retain their original player and learned abilities. May exceed supply capacity, but never the unit limit. Heroes and summoned or mechanical units leave no eligible corpse.

abilities.name: Raise Dead
abilities.description: Consume one nearby corpse in the selected area and raise two shadow spirits for your player for 40 seconds. The corpse cannot be resurrected afterward. Optional autocast is off by default and raises reinforcements when enemies are nearby. Uses our existing forest-spirit model in place of skeletons.

abilities.name: Animate Dead
abilities.description: Reanimate up to six nearby fallen units for your army for 40 seconds, strongest first. They retain their original bodies and are immune to weapon damage, spell damage and hostile spells. Temporary units cannot leave reusable corpses. May exceed supply capacity; the hard unit limit still applies.

abilities.name: Reincarnation
abilities.description: When this hero dies, return at the death site after seven seconds with full health and mana. Retains identity, items and learned abilities. Triggers once every four minutes. If terrain stays blocked for ten more seconds, remains available for normal altar revival. Uses this game’s ordinary death rewards.

abilities.name: Dismiss Summon
abilities.description: Dispel an enemy summoned non-hero of level six or lower, dealing 600 spell damage to the summon. This piercing dispel can remove Spell Ward. Ordinary units and heroes cannot be selected.

abilities.name: Searing Arrows
abilities.description: Toggle flaming arrows. Each released arrow spends 8 mana for 10/20/30 additional weapon damage. Without enough mana, a normal arrow fires. Silence suppresses the enhancement; released arrows keep their damage.

abilities.name: Unstoppable
abilities.description: Protect an ally from stuns, roots, silence, disarm, item lockout, movement slows and attack slows for 4/6/8 seconds. Existing controls are suppressed while protected; their timers keep running. Incoming control components are prevented. Damage, armor penalties and other spell components still apply. This protection can be dispelled.

abilities.name: Banish
abilities.description: Turn a non-mechanical unit ethereal for 12/15/18 seconds (4/5/6 on heroes). It cannot attack or take physical damage, but can move and cast spells. Movement is slowed by 50%, and spell damage taken increases by 66%. Can target allies or enemies; can be dispelled.

abilities.name: Frost Arrows
abilities.description: Fire one icy weapon shot: +5/10/15 damage and 30/50/70% movement and attack slow for five seconds (1.5 seconds on heroes). Costs 10 mana at weapon release. Autocast enhances existing attacks when affordable. Uses the caster’s weapon timing and range; choose an Archer in the workbench.

abilities.name: Carrion Spirits
abilities.description: Consume one nearby corpse to summon a permanent forest spirit, up to five retained per caster across ranks. Spirits survive their caster. Adapts Warcraft III Carrion Beetles mechanics using our existing forest-spirit models; it does not introduce a beetle model.

abilities.name: Spirit Companion
abilities.description: Summon one permanent forest-spirit companion. It ends when its source dies, disappears or changes controller. Recasting replaces only the previous owned companion, and only after successful placement. A generic source-linked summon proof.

abilities.name: Flight Form
abilities.description: Toggle a flying wasp form at 7 world units above terrain. Uses our existing Needle Wasp model; identity, health, supply and body size remain unchanged. Toggle off to land nearby. If blocked, stay airborne until safe ground becomes available.

abilities.name: Faultline
abilities.description: Slam the mace to send a travelling fracture through enemies: 70/110/150 spell damage and a brief 0.4/0.5/0.6-second stun. Heroes are stunned for half as long.

abilities.name: Rally the Colony
abilities.description: Protect up to sixteen nearby allies for eight seconds: absorb 50/80/110 damage and increase attack damage by 10/15/20%. The attack bonus remains if the shield breaks.

abilities.name: Iron Carapace
abilities.description: Harden the Marshal’s chitin for six seconds: take 20/30/40% less damage and reflect 15/25/35% of ordinary melee damage actually suffered. The Marshal can still move and cast.

abilities.name: Crownfall
abilities.description: Call down an amber crown with a thunderous mace strike. After a visible windup, deal 180/260 spell damage and stun enemies for 1/1.4 seconds (half against heroes) in a 7/9-unit radius. Up to sixteen allies in the impact area gain a 100/160-damage shield for six seconds.
